posts.title: RCC - 125th Anniversary Celebration
posts.summary_es: ¡Todos están invitados! La Ridgeview Congregational Church celebrará su 125 Aniversario el domingo, 11 de octubre de 2026. Todos son bienvenidos a unirse a nosotros a las 10:30 para nuestro servicio de adoración de celebración, seguido de refrescos. Ministra Invitada: Rev. Dra. Marsha Williamsp
posts.summary:
You are all Invited!
The Ridgeview Congregational Church will celebrate its 125th Anniversary on Sunday, October 11th, 2026. All are welcome to join us at 10:30 for our celebratory worship service, followed by refreshments. 
Guest Minister: Rev. Dr. Marsha Williamsp

posts.title: Fisher Hill Block Party
posts.location: Ridgeview Ave (Midland Ave to Tibbits Ave)
posts.summary: The FHA will be sponsoring a Fisher Hill Block Party on Sept 19th. The Block Party will be held on Ridgeview Ave between Midland Ave and Tibbits Ave. Ridgeview will be closed to automobiles between Midland and Tibbits.
posts.summary_es: La FHA patrocinará una fiesta vecinal de Fisher Hill el 19 de septiembre. La fiesta se celebrará en Ridgeview Ave, entre Midland Ave y Tibbits Ave. Ridgeview estará cerrada a los automóviles entre Midland y Tibbits.
